en.t: The Julian calendar takes effect as the civil calendar of the Roman Republic, establishing January 1 as the new date of the new year
en.s: The Julian calendar is a solar calendar of 365 days in every year with an additional leap day every fourth year (without exception). The Julian calendar is still used as a religious calendar in parts of the Eastern Orthodox Church and in parts of Oriental Orthodoxy as well as in the Berber calendar.

zh.t: 儒略历成为罗马共和国的民用历法，以1月1日为新年的起点
zh.s: 儒略历是一种太阳历，每年365天，每四年增设一个闰日，没有例外。东正教部分教会、东方正统教会部分教会，以及柏柏尔历法，至今仍将儒略历用作宗教历法。

en.s: Publius Helvius Pertinax ( PER-tin-ax; 1 August 126 – 28 March 193) was Roman emperor for the first three months of 193, succeeding Commodus and becoming the first ruler of the turbulent Year of the Five Emperors. The son of a freedman, Pertinax rose from modest origins through a military career. He distinguished himself in the Roman–Parthian War of 161–166 and went on to hold a succession of governorships and senior commands.

zh.s: 普布利乌斯·赫尔维乌斯·佩尔蒂纳克斯生于126年8月1日，卒于193年3月28日，接替康茂德，在193年的头三个月担任罗马皇帝，是动荡的“五帝之年”的首位统治者。他是获释奴隶之子，出身平凡，通过军旅生涯逐步晋升。他在161—166年的罗马与帕提亚战争中表现突出，此后历任多个行省总督及高级军事职务。

en.s: Huan Xuan (Chinese: 桓玄; pinyin: Huán Xuán) (369 – 19 June 404), courtesy name Jingdao (敬道), nickname Lingbao (靈寶), formally Emperor Wudao of Chu (楚武悼帝), was an Eastern Jin Dynasty warlord who briefly took over the imperial throne from Emperor An of Jin and declared his own state of Chu (Chinese: 楚; pinyin: Chǔ) in January 404, known in historiography as Huan Chu (Chinese: 桓楚; pinyin: Huán Chǔ), but was defeated by an uprising led by the general Liu Yu later in 404 and killed.

zh.s: 桓玄生于369年，卒于404年6月19日，字敬道，小字灵宝，谥号楚武悼帝，是东晋军阀。他短暂夺取晋安帝的皇位，于404年1月建立楚国，史称桓楚。同年，刘裕将军领导起兵，击败桓玄；桓玄随后被杀。

en.t: Romanos IV Diogenes marries Eudokia Makrembolitissa and is crowned Byzantine Emperor
en.s: Eudokia Makrembolitissa (Greek: Εὐδοκία Μακρεμβολίτισσα, romanized: Evdokía Makremvolítissa) was a Byzantine empress by her successive marriages to Constantine X Doukas and Romanos IV Diogenes. She acted as ruler with her two sons in 1067, and resigned her rule by marriage to Romanos IV Diogenes. When he was deposed in 1071 she resumed the rule with her son Michael VII, but was soon forced to resign again.

zh.t: 罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼迎娶欧多基娅·马克伦博利提萨，并加冕为拜占庭皇帝
zh.s: 欧多基娅·马克伦博利提萨先后嫁给君士坦丁十世·杜卡斯与罗曼努斯四世·第欧根尼，成为拜占庭皇后。1067年，她与两个儿子共同执政，后来因嫁给罗曼努斯四世而交出统治权。1071年罗曼努斯被废黜后，她与儿子米海尔七世恢复共治，但很快又被迫放弃统治。

en.t: Michael VIII Palaiologos is proclaimed co-emperor of the Empire of Nicaea with his ward John IV Laskaris
en.s: Michael VIII Palaiologos or Palaeologus (Greek: Μιχαὴλ Δούκας Ἄνγελος Κομνηνὸς Παλαιολόγος, romanized: Mikhaḗl Doúkās Ángelos Komnēnós Palaiológos; 1224 – 11 December 1282) reigned as Byzantine emperor from 1261 until his death in 1282, and previously as the co-emperor of the Empire of Nicaea from 1259 to 1261. Michael VIII was the founder of the Palaiologan dynasty that would rule the Byzantine Empire until the Fall of Constantinople in 1453.

zh.t: 米海尔八世·巴列奥略被拥立为尼西亚帝国共治皇帝，与其监护的约翰四世·拉斯卡里斯共同统治
zh.s: 米海尔八世·巴列奥略，全名米海尔·杜卡斯·安格洛斯·科穆宁·巴列奥略，生于1224年，卒于1282年12月11日。他于1261年至1282年去世前担任拜占庭皇帝，此前在1259年至1261年担任尼西亚帝国共治皇帝。他建立的巴列奥略王朝统治拜占庭帝国，直至1453年君士坦丁堡陷落。

en.s: The Battle of Calais took place in 1350 when an English force defeated an unsuspecting French army which was attempting to take the city. Despite a truce being in effect the French commander Geoffrey de Charny had planned to take the city by subterfuge, and bribed Amerigo of Pavia, an Italian officer of the city garrison, to open a gate for them.

zh.s: 加来战役发生于1350年，一支英军击败了试图夺取该城、却未料到遭到反击的法军。尽管双方当时处于休战状态，法国指挥官若弗鲁瓦·德沙尔尼仍计划以计谋夺城，并贿赂城中守军的一名意大利军官——帕维亚的阿梅里戈，让他为法军打开城门。

en.t: Albert II of Habsburg is crowned King of Hungary
en.s: The King of Hungary (Hungarian: Magyarország királya) was the ruling head of state of the Kingdom of Hungary from 1000 (or 1001) to 1918. The style of title "Apostolic King of Hungary" (Magyarország apostoli királya) was endorsed by Pope Clement XIII in 1758 and used afterwards by all monarchs of Hungary.

zh.t: 哈布斯堡家族的阿尔布雷希特二世加冕为匈牙利国王
zh.s: 匈牙利国王是匈牙利王国从1000年或1001年至1918年的统治者及国家元首。“匈牙利宗座国王”这一尊号于1758年获教皇克莱孟十三世认可，此后由匈牙利历任君主使用。

en.t: The present-day location of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is first explored by the Portuguese under their commissioned Florentine explorer, Amerigo Vespucci. Vespucci begins his suspicion that there is a whole continent between Europe and Asia
en.s: Rio de Janeiro, also known simply as Rio, is the capital and largest city of the state of Rio de Janeiro. It is the second-largest city in Brazil after São Paulo, and the largest by international tourists. It has a population of 6 million in the city proper, and 13 million people in its metropolitan area as of 2025. It is also the sixth-most-populous city in the Americas.

zh.t: 葡萄牙人委派的佛罗伦萨探险家亚美利哥·韦斯普奇首次探索今巴西里约热内卢一带；韦斯普奇开始怀疑欧洲与亚洲之间还有一整块大陆
zh.s: 里约热内卢简称里约，是巴西里约热内卢州的首府和最大城市。它是巴西仅次于圣保罗的第二大城市，也是巴西接待国际游客最多的城市。截至2025年，市区人口为600万，都市区人口为1,300万。它还是美洲人口第六多的城市。

en.t: Twenty-year-old Francis, Duke of Brittany, succeeds to the French throne following the death of his father-in-law, Louis XII
en.s: Francis I (French: François Ier; Middle French: Françoys; 12 September 1494 – 31 March 1547) was King of France from 1515 until his death in 1547. He was the son of Charles, Count of Angoulême, and Louise of Savoy. He succeeded his first cousin once removed and father-in-law Louis XII, who died without a legitimate son.

zh.t: 二十岁的布列塔尼公爵弗朗索瓦在岳父路易十二去世后继承法国王位
zh.s: 弗朗索瓦一世生于1494年9月12日，卒于1547年3月31日，自1515年起担任法国国王，直至1547年去世。他是昂古莱姆伯爵查理与萨伏依的路易丝之子。路易十二既是他的堂叔，也是他的岳父；路易十二去世时没有合法的儿子，弗朗索瓦因此继承王位。

en.s: The 1527 election in Cetin (Croatian: Cetinski / Cetingradski sabor, meaning Parliament on Cetin(grad) or Parliament of Cetin(grad), or Cetinski / Cetingradski izbor) was an assembly of the Croatian Parliament (Sabor) in the Cetin Castle in 1527. It followed a succession crisis in the Kingdom of Hungary caused by the death of Louis II, and which resulted in the Kingdom of Croatia joining the Habsburg monarchy.
en.n: Croatian nobles elect Ferdinand I, Archduke of Austria as King of Croatia in the 1527 election in Cetin.

zh.s: 1527年采廷选举是克罗地亚议会于1527年在采廷城堡举行的一次会议。其克罗地亚语名称也有“采廷议会”或“采廷格勒议会”之意。匈牙利国王拉约什二世去世后，匈牙利王国出现王位继承危机，此次会议在这一背景下举行，最终促使克罗地亚王国加入哈布斯堡君主国。
zh.n: 克罗地亚贵族在1527年采廷选举中，推选奥地利大公斐迪南一世为克罗地亚国王。

en.s: The Battle of Santo Domingo (1586) or the Capture of Santo Domingo was a military and naval action fought on 1 January 1586, of the recently declared Anglo-Spanish War that resulted in the assault and capture by English soldiers and sailors of the Spanish city of Santo Domingo governed by Cristóbal de Ovalle on the Spanish island of Hispaniola. The English were led by Francis Drake and was part of his Great Expedition to the raid the Spanish New World in a kind of preemptive strike. The English soldiers then occupied the city for over a month and captured much booty along with a 25,000 ducat ransom before departing on 1 February.

zh.s: 1586年1月1日，英西战争刚爆发不久，英军士兵和水手攻占了西班牙在伊斯帕尼奥拉岛上的圣多明各城，当时该城由克里斯托瓦尔·德·奥瓦列治理。这场海陆军事行动又称“攻占圣多明各”。英军由弗朗西斯·德雷克率领，是他远征美洲、袭击西班牙殖民地的一部分，带有先发制人的性质。英军随后占领该城一个多月，掠走大量财物，并索得25,000杜卡特赎金，于2月1日离开。

en.t: The Masque of Indian and China Knights is performed by courtiers of James VI and I at Hampton Court
en.s: The Masque of Indian and China Knights was performed at Hampton Court in Richmond, England on 1 January 1604. The masque was not published, and no text survives. It was described in a letter written by Dudley Carleton. The historian Leeds Barroll prefers the title, Masque of the Orient Knights.

zh.t: 詹姆斯六世及一世的廷臣在汉普顿宫上演《印度与中国骑士假面剧》
zh.s: 《印度与中国骑士假面剧》于1604年1月1日在英格兰里士满的汉普顿宫上演。该剧从未出版，文本也未能保存下来。达德利·卡尔顿在一封信中描述了这场演出。历史学家利兹·巴罗尔更倾向于将其称为《东方骑士假面剧》。

en.s: Charles II (1630–1685) was crowned King of Scotland and his other kingdoms at Scone Palace on 1 January 1651. His father, Charles I, had been executed in London at Whitehall Palace on 30 January 1649. Charles arrived in Scotland in June 1650 where there was support for his rule following the Treaty of Breda. Charles resided at old Gowrie House in Perth and held meetings in the summer house by the Tay.

zh.t: 查理二世在苏格兰加冕
zh.s: 查理二世（1630—1685年）于1651年1月1日在斯昆宫加冕为苏格兰及其其他王国的国王。他的父亲查理一世已于1649年1月30日在伦敦白厅宫被处决。1650年6月，《布雷达条约》签署后，查理抵达苏格兰，当地有人支持他执政。他住在珀斯的旧高里宅邸，并在泰河畔的夏屋举行会议。

en.t: John V is proclaimed King of Portugal and the Algarves in Lisbon
en.s: Dom John V (22 October 1689 – 31 July 1750), known as the Magnanimous and the Portuguese Sun King, was King of Portugal from 9 December 1706 until his death in 1750. His reign saw the rise of Portugal and the Portuguese Empire to new levels of prosperity, wealth, and prestige among European courts.

zh.t: 若昂五世在里斯本被宣布为葡萄牙及阿尔加维国王
zh.s: 若昂五世生于1689年10月22日，卒于1750年7月31日，被称为“宽宏者”和“葡萄牙太阳王”，自1706年12月9日起担任葡萄牙国王，直至1750年去世。在他的统治下，葡萄牙及葡萄牙帝国的繁荣、财富与在欧洲宫廷中的声望都达到新高度。

en.s: The invasion of Russia by Charles XII of Sweden was a campaign undertaken during the Great Northern War between Sweden and the allied states of Russia, Poland, and Denmark. The invasion began with Charles's crossing of the Vistula on 1 January 1708, and effectively ended with the Swedish defeat in the Battle of Poltava on 8 July 1709, though Charles continued to pose a military threat to Russia for several years while under the protection of the Ottoman Turks.

zh.s: 瑞典国王卡尔十二世入侵俄国，是大北方战争期间瑞典与俄罗斯、波兰、丹麦同盟之间的一场军事行动。入侵始于卡尔于1708年1月1日渡过维斯瓦河，实际上以瑞典军队在1709年7月8日的波尔塔瓦战役中战败告终。不过，此后数年，卡尔在奥斯曼土耳其人的庇护下，仍对俄罗斯构成军事威胁。

en.s: The Battle of St. John's was the French capture of St. John's, the capital of the British colony of Newfoundland, on 1 January 1709 [O.S. 21 December 1708], during Queen Anne's War. A mixed and motley force of 164 men led by Joseph de Monbeton de Brouillan de Saint-Ovide, king's lieutenant to Philippe Pastour de Costebelle, the French governor of Plaisance, quickly overwhelmed the British garrison at St. John's, and took about 500 prisoners.

zh.s: 安妮女王战争期间，法军于1709年1月1日（旧历1708年12月21日）攻占英国纽芬兰殖民地首府圣约翰斯，史称圣约翰斯战役。一支成分复杂的164人部队迅速击溃当地英军守军，俘虏约500人。部队由约瑟夫·德·蒙贝通·德·布鲁扬·德·圣奥维德率领，他是法国普莱桑斯总督菲利普·帕斯图尔·德·科斯特贝尔麾下的王室副官。

en.t: J. S. Bach led the first performance of his chorale cantata Jesu, nun sei gepreiset, which features trumpet fanfares at the start and end
en.s: Jesu, nun sei gepreiset (Jesus, now be praised), BWV 41, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He composed it in Leipzig for New Year's Day and first performed it on 1 January 1725. It is based on the hymn of the same name that Johannes Hermann wrote for the same occasion, published in 1591.

zh.t: 巴赫指挥众赞歌康塔塔《耶稣，如今当受赞美》首演，作品开头与结尾均有小号号角乐句
zh.s: 《耶稣，如今当受赞美》（Jesu, nun sei gepreiset，BWV 41）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫创作的一部教会康塔塔。他在莱比锡为元旦创作此曲，并于1725年1月1日首次演出。作品以约翰内斯·赫尔曼为同一节日所作、1591年出版的同名赞美诗为基础。

en.t: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Herr Gott, dich loben wir, BWV 16, his church cantata for New Year's Day to a libretto by Georg Christian Lehms
en.s: Herr Gott, dich loben wir (Lord God, we praise You), BWV 16, is a church cantata for New Year's Day by Johann Sebastian Bach. It was first performed on 1 January 1726 in Leipzig, as part of the composer's third cantata cycle. Its libretto is by Georg Christian Lehms, as for three other of Bach's cantatas for the Christmas season that started with Unser Mund sei voll Lachens, BWV 110 on Christmas Day.

zh.t: 约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫指挥元旦教会康塔塔《主上帝，我们赞美你》（BWV 16）首演，歌词由格奥尔格·克里斯蒂安·莱姆斯创作
zh.s: 《主上帝，我们赞美你》（Herr Gott, dich loben wir，BWV 16）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫为元旦创作的教会康塔塔，作为他第三套康塔塔年作的一部分，于1726年1月1日在莱比锡首演。歌词作者是格奥尔格·克里斯蒂安·莱姆斯；巴赫同一圣诞节期的另外三部康塔塔也采用了他的歌词。这一节期的演出从圣诞节当天的《我们的口中充满欢笑》（BWV 110）开始。

en.t: Bouvet Island, the world's remotest island, is discovered by French explorer Jean-Baptiste Charles Bouvet de Lozier
en.s: Bouvet Island ( BOO-vay; Norwegian: Bouvetøya [bʉˈvèːœʏɑ]) is an uninhabited subantarctic volcanic island and dependency of Norway. A protected nature reserve situated in the South Atlantic Ocean at the southern end of the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, it is the world's most remote island. Located north of 60°S latitude, Bouvet Island is not part of the southern region covered by the Antarctic Treaty System.

zh.t: 法国探险家让-巴蒂斯特·夏尔·布韦·德洛齐耶发现世界上最偏远的岛屿布韦岛
zh.s: 布韦岛是一座无人居住的亚南极火山岛，也是挪威的属地。它位于南大西洋、大西洋中脊南端，被划为自然保护区，是世界上最偏远的岛屿。布韦岛位于南纬60度以北，因此不属于《南极条约体系》覆盖的南部地区。

en.s: On January 1, 1776, during the American Revolutionary War, British Royal Navy ships began shelling Norfolk, Virginia, and landing parties came ashore to burn specific properties. The town, whose significantly Loyalist population had fled, was occupied by Patriot forces from Virginia and North Carolina. Although the Patriots worked to drive off the British landing parties, they did nothing to impede the progress of the flames, and began burning and looting Loyalist-owned property instead.

zh.s: 1776年1月1日，美国独立战争期间，英国皇家海军舰艇开始炮击弗吉尼亚州诺福克，登陆部队上岸烧毁特定房产。镇上原有的大量效忠派居民已经逃离，当时由弗吉尼亚和北卡罗来纳的爱国派部队占据。爱国派虽试图击退英军登陆部队，却没有阻止火势蔓延，反而开始纵火焚烧、抢掠效忠派的财产。

en.s: The Pennsylvania Line Mutiny was a mutiny of Continental Army soldiers, who demanded higher pay and better housing conditions, and was the cause of the legend and stories surrounding the American heroine Tempe Wick. The mutiny began on January 1, 1781, and ended with a negotiated settlement on January 8, 1781. The negotiated terms were finally concluded by January 29, 1781.

zh.s: 1781年1月1日，大陆军宾夕法尼亚部队的士兵发动兵变，要求提高军饷并改善住宿条件。兵变于1月8日经谈判解决，相关协议条款到1月29日最终敲定。这场兵变也成为围绕美国女英雄坦佩·威克的传说与故事的起因。

en.t: The first edition of The Times of London, previously The Daily Universal Register, is published
en.s: The Times is a British daily national newspaper based in London. It began in 1785 under the title The Daily Universal Register, adopting its modern name on 1 January 1788. The Times and its sister paper, The Sunday Times (founded in 1821), are published by Times Media, since 1981 a subsidiary of News UK, in turn wholly owned by News Corp.

zh.t: 原名《每日环球记录报》的伦敦《泰晤士报》以新报名字样首次出版
zh.s: 《泰晤士报》是一份总部位于伦敦的英国全国性日报，1785年以《每日环球记录报》之名创刊，并于1788年1月1日改用现名。《泰晤士报》及其姊妹报、1821年创刊的《星期日泰晤士报》，均由Times Media出版。该公司自1981年起隶属于英国新闻集团（News UK），后者由新闻集团（News Corp）全资拥有。

en.s: The action of 1 January 1800 was a naval battle of the Quasi-War that took place off the coast of present-day Haiti, near the island of Gonâve in the Bight of Léogâne. The battle was fought between an American convoy of four merchant vessels escorted by the United States naval schooner USS Experiment, and a squadron of armed barges manned by Haitians known as picaroons.

zh.s: 1800年1月1日海战发生于美法准战争期间，地点在今海地近海的莱奥甘湾、戈纳夫岛附近。交战双方为一支由四艘商船组成、由美国海军双桅纵帆船“实验”号（USS Experiment）护航的美国船队，以及一支由海地人驾驶的武装驳船队，这些人被称为“皮卡龙”海盗。

en.t: The legislative union of Kingdom of Great Britain and Kingdom of Ireland is completed, and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland is proclaimed
en.s: The Kingdom of Ireland was a dependency of England from 1542 to 1707, and then of Great Britain from 1707 to 1800. It was ruled by the monarchs of England and then of Great Britain in personal union, and was administered from Dublin Castle by a viceroy appointed by the English king: the Lord Lieutenant of Ireland.

zh.t: 大不列颠王国与爱尔兰王国完成议会合并，宣布成立大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国
zh.s: 爱尔兰王国在1542年至1707年是英格兰的属国，1707年至1800年则为大不列颠的属国。它先后与英格兰、大不列颠共戴一位君主，组成共主邦联，并由国王任命的爱尔兰总督在都柏林城堡治理。

en.s: Ceres is a dwarf planet in the main asteroid belt between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter. It was the first object identified in the asteroid belt, discovered on 1 January 1801 by Giuseppe Piazzi at Palermo Astronomical Observatory in Sicily, and announced as a new planet. Ceres was later classified as an asteroid, and then more recently as the only confirmed dwarf planet within the asteroid belt, and the largest without a moon.

zh.s: 谷神星是火星与木星轨道之间主小行星带中的一颗矮行星。1801年1月1日，朱塞佩·皮亚齐在西西里岛巴勒莫天文台发现了它，并将其作为一颗新行星公布；它也是小行星带中首个被发现的天体。谷神星后来被归类为小行星，近代又被认定为小行星带中唯一已确认的矮行星，也是没有卫星的矮行星中最大的一颗。

en.t: French rule ends in Haiti. Haiti becomes the first black-majority republic and second independent country in North America after the United States
en.s: Saint-Domingue (French: [sɛ̃ dɔmɛ̃ɡ] ) was a French colony in the western portion of the Caribbean island of Hispaniola, in the area of modern-day Haiti, from 1659 to 1803. The name derives from the Spanish main city on the island, Santo Domingo, which came to refer specifically to the Spanish-held Captaincy General of Santo Domingo, now the Dominican Republic.

zh.t: 法国在海地的统治结束；海地成为首个黑人占多数的共和国，以及北美洲继美国之后第二个独立国家
zh.s: 圣多明格是1659年至1803年法国在加勒比海伊斯帕尼奥拉岛西部的殖民地，大致位于今天的海地境内。其名称源自岛上的西班牙主要城市圣多明各；圣多明各这一名称后来专指西班牙控制的圣多明各都督府，即今天的多米尼加共和国。

en.s: The Act Prohibiting Importation of Slaves of 1807 (2 Stat. 426, enacted March 2, 1807) is a United States federal law that prohibits the importation of slaves into the United States. It took effect on January 1, 1808, the earliest date permitted by the United States Constitution. This legislation was promoted by President Thomas Jefferson, who called for its enactment in his 1806 State of the Union address.
en.n: This entry records the entry into force, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 《1807年禁止输入奴隶法》是禁止向美国输入奴隶的联邦法律，收录于《美国法令大全》第2卷第426页，颁布于1807年3月2日。该法于1808年1月1日生效，这是《美国宪法》允许实施此类禁令的最早日期。总统托马斯·杰斐逊推动制定这项法律，曾在1806年国情咨文中呼吁立法。

en.s: The Battle of Castellón was an ambush against a French Imperial detachment under General Reille near Girona during the Peninsular War (1807–1814).

zh.s: 卡斯特利翁战役发生于半岛战争（1807—1814年）期间，是在赫罗纳附近对雷耶将军指挥的一支法国帝国军分遣队实施的伏击。

en.s: The Battle of Koregaon was fought on 1 January 1818 between the British East India Company and the Peshwa faction of the Maratha Confederacy, at Koregaon Bhima. The 28,000-strong Marathas, led by Peshwa Baji Rao II intended to attack Pune. On their way, they were met by an 800-strong Company force that was on its way to reinforce the British troops in Pune. The Peshwa dispatched around 2,000 soldiers to attack the Company force stationed in Koregaon. Led by Captain Francis Staunton, the Company troops defended their position for nearly 12 hours.

zh.s: 1818年1月1日，英国东印度公司军队与马拉塔联盟的佩什瓦一派在科雷冈比马交战。佩什瓦巴吉·拉奥二世率领28,000人的马拉塔军队，计划进攻浦那。他们在途中遇上一支800人的东印度公司部队，该部队正赶往浦那增援英军。佩什瓦派出约2,000人，攻击驻守科雷冈的公司军队。弗朗西斯·斯汤顿上尉率领守军坚守阵地近12小时。

en.s: Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus is an 1818 Gothic novel written by English author Mary Shelley. It tells the story of Victor Frankenstein, a young scientist who creates a sapient creature from different body parts in an unorthodox scientific experiment. Shelley started writing the story when she was 18 near Geneva and later worked on the novel in Bath, and the first edition was published anonymously in London on 1 January 1818, when she was 20.

zh.s: 《弗兰肯斯坦，或现代普罗米修斯》是英国作家玛丽·雪莱于1818年出版的哥特小说，讲述年轻科学家维克托·弗兰肯斯坦通过非常规科学实验，将不同身体部位拼合，创造出一个具有智慧的生命的故事。雪莱18岁时在日内瓦附近开始创作这一故事，后来又在巴斯继续写作这部小说。初版于1818年1月1日在伦敦匿名出版，当时她20岁。

en.s: The Greek Constitution of 1822 was a document adopted by the First National Assembly of Epidaurus on 1 January 1822. Formally it was the Provisional Regime of Greece (Greek: Προσωρινό Πολίτευμα της Ελλάδος), sometimes translated as Temporary Constitution of Greece. Considered to be the first constitution of Modern Greece, it was an attempt to achieve temporary governmental and military organisation until the future establishment of a national parliament.

zh.s: 1822年希腊宪法是埃皮达鲁斯第一届国民议会于1822年1月1日通过的文件，正式名称为《希腊临时政体》，有时译为《希腊临时宪法》。它被认为是现代希腊的第一部宪法，旨在未来建立国家议会之前，暂时组织政府与军事机构。

en.s: The 1827 Maryland gubernatorial election was held on January 1, 1827, in order to elect the governor of Maryland. Incumbent Democratic-Republican governor Joseph Kent was re-elected by the Maryland General Assembly against fellow Democratic-Republican candidate Isaac McKim.

zh.s: 1827年1月1日，马里兰州举行州长选举。州议会选出现任民主共和党州长约瑟夫·肯特连任，另一名民主共和党候选人艾萨克·麦金落选。

en.t: The world's first "Mercy" Hospital is founded in Pittsburgh, United States, by a group of Sisters of Mercy from Ireland; the name will go on to grace over 30 major hospitals throughout the world
en.s: UPMC Mercy is a main hospital facility of the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center (UPMC) and is located in the Uptown section of the city of Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, adjacent to Duquesne University, and a few blocks from the PPG Paints Arena and downtown Pittsburgh. It is the first chartered hospital to have been founded in the city of Pittsburgh and it is also the first hospital in the world to have been established by the Sisters of Mercy.

zh.t: 来自爱尔兰的仁慈修女会修女在美国匹兹堡创办世界首家“仁慈医院”；此后全球三十多家大型医院沿用这一名称
zh.s: UPMC仁慈医院是匹兹堡大学医学中心（UPMC）的一家主要医院，位于宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡的上城区，毗邻杜肯大学，距PPG涂料竞技场和匹兹堡市中心仅数个街区。这是匹兹堡首家取得特许状的医院，也是世界上首家由仁慈修女会创办的医院。

en.s: The 1855 City of Toronto Municipal Election was the City's 21st municipal election. Polling occurred on the first Monday and Tuesday of the year, January 1st and 2nd. Elections for Aldermen and Councilmen were held in seven wards and for the Municipal License Inspector. Violence and intimidation over political control of St. John's Ward by candidates who represented the Orange Order marred the election.

zh.s: 1855年多伦多市政选举是该市第21届市政选举，投票在当年的第一个星期一和星期二，即1月1日和2日进行。七个选区选举市议员和区议员，同时选举市政执照检查员。代表奥兰治会的候选人为争夺圣约翰选区的政治控制权，使用暴力和恐吓手段，使这场选举蒙上阴影。

en.s: The Battle of Castillejos was fought on New Year's Day, 1860, between the Spanish Army of Africa under Leopoldo O'Donnell and the Moroccan Army under Mawlay Abbas in Fnideq (Castillejos) as the Spanish army attempted to capture the cities of Tétouan and Tangier. The Spanish were victorious.

zh.s: 卡斯蒂列霍斯战役于1860年元旦在夫尼迪克，即卡斯蒂列霍斯进行，交战双方为莱奥波尔多·奥唐奈率领的西班牙非洲军团，与穆莱·阿巴斯指挥的摩洛哥军队。当时西班牙军队正试图攻占得土安和丹吉尔，战斗以西班牙获胜告终。

en.s: Crook's 1862 Expedition was an engagement of the American Civil War in western Virginia (the present state of West Virginia). Major General George Crook's forces advanced northward to Braxton County's community of Sutton, which had reportedly been occupied and burned by Confederate forces on December 29, 1861. The report turned out to be false.

zh.s: 克鲁克1862年远征是美国内战期间发生在弗吉尼亚州西部，即今西弗吉尼亚州的一次军事行动。乔治·克鲁克少将的部队向北推进至布拉克斯顿县萨顿镇，此前有消息称邦联部队于1861年12月29日占领并焚烧了该镇。后来证实，这一消息并不属实。

en.s: The Battle of Galveston was a naval and land battle of the American Civil War, when Confederate forces under Major Gen. John B. Magruder expelled occupying Union troops from the city of Galveston, Texas on January 1, 1863. After the loss of the cutter Harriet Lane, the Union Fleet Commander William B. Renshaw blew up the stranded vessel USS Westfield to save it from falling into enemy hands.

zh.s: 加尔维斯顿战役是美国内战期间的一场海陆战斗。1863年1月1日，邦联少将约翰·B.马格鲁德率部将占领得克萨斯州加尔维斯顿的联邦军赶出城。联邦军失去快艇“哈丽特·莱恩”号后，舰队司令威廉·B.伦肖炸毁了搁浅的“韦斯特菲尔德”号军舰，以免其落入敌手。

en.s: The Battle of River Feio or First Withdrawal, was an episode that occurred even at the beginning of the Mato Grosso Campaign in which about 200 Brazilians between civilians and soldiers under the command of Col. Dias da Silva faced a Paraguayan column of 2,000 men commanded by Captain Blas Rojas.

zh.s: 费奥河战役又称第一次撤退，是马托格罗索战役初期的一次战斗。迪亚斯·达席尔瓦上校指挥约200名巴西平民和军人，迎战布拉斯·罗哈斯上尉率领的一支2,000人巴拉圭纵队。

en.s: The sacking of Asunción was the occupation of the Paraguayan capital carried out as of January 1, 1869 by Brazilian forces in the Triple Alliance led by General João de Souza da Fonseca Costa. Asunción was deserted, evacuated by all its inhabitants two days before. On January 5, Luís Alves de Lima e Silva, then Marquis of Caxias, entered the city with the rest of the army.

zh.s: 1869年1月1日起，三国同盟中的巴西军队在若昂·德索萨·达丰塞卡·科斯塔将军率领下，占领巴拉圭首都亚松森。城内居民已在两天前全部撤离，当时亚松森是一座空城。1月5日，时任卡希亚斯侯爵的路易斯·阿尔维斯·德利马-席尔瓦率其余部队进入该城。

en.t: Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom is proclaimed Empress of India
en.s: Victoria (Alexandrina Victoria; 24 May 1819 – 22 January 1901) was Queen of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland from 20 June 1837 until her death in 1901. Her reign of 63 years and 216 days, which was longer than those of any of her predecessors, constituted the Victorian era, a period of industrial, political, scientific, and military change within the United Kingdom marked by a great expansion of the British Empire.

zh.t: 英国维多利亚女王被宣布为印度女皇
zh.s: 维多利亚女王本名亚历山德丽娜·维多利亚，生于1819年5月24日，卒于1901年1月22日。她自1837年6月20日起担任大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国女王，直至1901年去世。在位63年216天，超过此前所有君主。她的统治时期被称为维多利亚时代，英国在工业、政治、科学和军事方面发生变化，大英帝国也大幅扩张。

en.t: Italy issues the decree organising the Colony of Eritrea
en.s: A royal decree dated 1 January 1890 organised a civil administration for the Colony of Eritrea. The Italian legal record dates the measure to January 1 and its publication in the official gazette to January 7.
en.n: Decree date; official-gazette publication followed on January 7, 1890.

zh.t: 意大利颁布组建厄立特里亚殖民地的法令
zh.s: 一项日期为1890年1月1日的王室法令，为厄立特里亚殖民地组建了民政管理机构。意大利法律档案记载，该项措施的日期为1月1日，刊登于官方公报的日期为1月7日。
zh.n: 此处记录法令日期；法令随后于1890年1月7日刊登在官方公报上。

en.s: The Battle of Kakarong de Sili was fought on January 1, 1897, near Pandi, Bulacan, in the Philippines. The Kakarong Republic, based in the little fort in Pandi, was attacked by a force of Spaniards who massacred the Katipuneros there. At the end of the battle, General Eusebio Roque (also known as Maestrong Sebio and Dimabungo) was captured by the Spaniards.

zh.s: 1897年1月1日，菲律宾布拉干省潘迪附近爆发卡卡龙德西利战役。卡卡龙共和国以潘迪的一座小堡垒为据点，西班牙军队进攻此地，并屠杀了当地的卡蒂普南成员。战斗结束时，西班牙人俘虏了尤塞比奥·罗克将军，他也被称为Maestrong Sebio和Dimabungo。

en.t: Australia’s six colonies form a federation
en.s: The Commonwealth of Australia came into existence when six British colonies joined in a federation. New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, South Australia, Western Australia, and Tasmania became states under a federal constitution. The change followed years of conventions, political negotiations, and referendums about how power should be shared. A Commonwealth government took responsibility for specified national matters while the states retained their own governments and substantial powers. Federation established the institutional framework of modern Australia, although connections with Britain continued. The new political arrangement also excluded many people from full participation, including Indigenous Australians and others affected by discriminatory policies.

zh.t: 澳大利亚六个殖民地组成联邦
zh.s: 六个英国殖民地联合组成联邦，澳大利亚联邦由此成立。新南威尔士、维多利亚、昆士兰、南澳大利亚、西澳大利亚和塔斯马尼亚依据联邦宪法成为六个州。在此之前，各方围绕如何分配权力，经历了多年的制宪会议、政治谈判和全民公投。联邦政府负责宪法规定的全国性事务，各州则保留自己的政府和相当大的权力。联邦制奠定了现代澳大利亚的制度框架，但澳大利亚与英国的联系仍然延续。这一新体制也没有让所有人获得充分的政治参与权，澳大利亚原住民及其他受到歧视政策影响的群体仍被排除在外。

en.t: The Southern Nigeria Protectorate is established within the British Empire
en.s: Southern Nigeria was a British protectorate in the coastal areas of modern-day Nigeria formed in 1900 from the union of the Niger Coast Protectorate with territories chartered by the Royal Niger Company below Lokoja on the Niger River. The Lagos colony was later added in 1906, and the territory was officially renamed the Colony and Protectorate of Southern Nigeria.

zh.t: 大英帝国设立南尼日利亚保护国
zh.s: 南尼日利亚是英国在今尼日利亚沿海地区设立的保护国，1900年由尼日尔海岸保护国与尼日尔河洛科贾下游、皇家尼日尔公司特许管理的领地合并而成。1906年，拉各斯殖民地并入，领地正式更名为南尼日利亚殖民地及保护国。

en.s: Sir Edmund "Toby" Barton (18 January 1849 – 7 January 1920) was the first prime minister of Australia, serving from 1901 to 1903. He held office as the leader of the Protectionist Party, before resigning in 1903 to become a founding justice of the High Court of Australia, on which he served until his death in 1920.

zh.t: 埃德蒙·巴顿就任澳大利亚首任总理
zh.s: 埃德蒙·“托比”·巴顿爵士生于1849年1月18日，卒于1920年1月7日，是澳大利亚首任总理，任期为1901年至1903年。他作为保护主义党领袖执政，1903年辞去总理职务，成为澳大利亚高等法院首批法官之一，直至1920年去世前一直在该院任职。

en.t: The first American college football bowl game, the Rose Bowl between Michigan and Stanford, is held in Pasadena, California
en.s: The Rose Bowl Game is an annual American college football bowl game, traditionally played on January 1 (New Year's Day) at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, California. When New Year's Day falls on a Sunday, the game is played on Monday, January 2. Nicknamed "The Granddaddy of Them All" by broadcaster Keith Jackson, it was the first postseason football game ever established.

zh.t: 美国首场大学橄榄球碗赛——密歇根大学对斯坦福大学的玫瑰碗赛——在加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳举行
zh.s: 玫瑰碗赛是一项年度美国大学橄榄球碗赛，传统上于1月1日元旦在加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的玫瑰碗球场举行。若元旦适逢星期日，比赛则移至1月2日星期一。解说员基思·杰克逊将其称为“碗赛鼻祖”，它是最早创办的赛季后橄榄球比赛。

en.t: The Republic of China is established
en.s: The Republic of China established its governance over mainland China on 1 January 1912 following the Xinhai Revolution, which overthrew the Manchu-led Qing dynasty and ended China's imperial history. The Beiyang government in Beijing was the internationally recognized government of the ROC from 1912 to 1928, with regional warlords occupying parts of the country after the death of Beiyang leader Yuan Shikai in 1916.

zh.s: 辛亥革命推翻满族统治的清朝、结束中国帝制后，中华民国于1912年1月1日在中国大陆建立政权。1912年至1928年，北京的北洋政府是国际承认的中华民国政府。北洋领袖袁世凯于1916年去世后，地方军阀割据了国内部分地区。

en.s: The Second Battle of Las Cruces, or the New Year's Day Battle, was a major engagement during the American occupation of Nicaragua. It was fought on 1 January 1928, during an expedition to destroy a Sandinista fortress. A column of United States Marines and Nicaraguan National Guardsmen were attacked by a superior force of rebels entrenched on Las Cruises Hill and, after a long battle, the Americans and Nicaraguans routed the Sandinistas and captured their positions.

zh.t: 第二次拉斯克鲁塞斯战役（1928年）
zh.s: 1928年1月1日，第二次拉斯克鲁塞斯战役，又称元旦战役，在美国占领尼加拉瓜期间爆发，是当时的一场重要战斗。一支美国海军陆战队与尼加拉瓜国民警卫队组成的纵队，奉命摧毁桑地诺派的一座堡垒，途中遭到固守拉斯克鲁塞斯山的优势叛军袭击。经过长时间战斗，美军和尼加拉瓜军队击溃桑地诺派，并攻占其阵地。

en.t: A "Law for the Prevention of Genetically Diseased Offspring" comes into effect in Nazi Germany
en.s: The social policies of eugenics in Nazi Germany were composed of various ideas about genetics. The racial ideology of Nazism placed the biological improvement of the German people by selective breeding of "Nordic" or "Aryan" traits at its center. These policies were used to justify the involuntary sterilization and mass murder of those deemed "undesirable".

en.s: The Declaration by United Nations was the main treaty that formalized the Allies of World War II and was signed by 47 national governments between 1942 and 1945. en.s: Operation Bodenplatte (German: [ˈboːdn̩ˌplatə]; "Baseplate"), launched on 1 January 1945, was an attempt by the German Luftwaffe to cripple Allied air forces in the Low Countries during the Second World War. en.t: The Canadian Citizenship Act 1946 comes into effect, converting British subjects into Canadian citizens. Prime Minister William Lyon Mackenzie King becomes the first Canadian citizen

Before 1949, it referred to almost all people born in the British Empire (including the United Kingdom, Dominions, and colonies, but excluding protectorates and protected states). Between 1949 and 1983, the term was synonymous with Commonwealth citizen. Currently, it refers to people possessing a class of British nationality largely granted under limited circumstances to those connected with Ireland or British India born before 1949.

en.t: The British railway network is nationalized to form British Railways
en.s: British Railways, which after 1965 traded as British Rail, was the state-owned company responsible for rail transport in Great Britain from its inception in 1948 to its privatisation in the 1990s, with the organisation officially becoming defunct in 1997. en.s: The Cuban Revolution (1953–59) was an armed revolt conducted by Fidel Castro's 26th of July Movement and its allies against the authoritarian government of Cuban President Fulgencio Batista. The revolution began in July 1953, and continued sporadically until the rebels finally ousted Batista on 1 January 1959, replacing his government with a revolutionary socialist state. The 26th of July Movement later reformed along communist lines, becoming the Communist Party in October 1965. The Cuban Revolution had powerful domestic and international repercussions. In particular, it reshaped Cuba's relationship with the United States. Efforts to improve diplomatic relations have gained momentum in recent years.

zh.s: 1953至1959年，菲德尔·卡斯特罗领导的“七二六运动”及其盟友发动武装起义，反对古巴总统富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔的威权政府。革命于1953年7月开始，此后斗争时断时续，直到1959年1月1日起义军推翻巴蒂斯塔，建立革命社会主义国家。“七二六运动”后来按共产主义路线改组，并于1965年10月成为共产党。古巴革命对国内外产生重大影响，尤其改变了古巴与美国的关系。原文还指出，近年来推动两国改善外交关系的努力有所加强。

en.s: The Joint Communiqué on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations on January 1, 1979 was announced on December 15, 1978 (16th in China), which established official relations between the United States and the People's Republic of China (commonly called "China"). Its announcement coincided with the ending of U.S. official recognition of the Republic of China (now commonly known as "Taiwan"), which was announced by President Jimmy Carter in December 1978.
en.n: Diplomatic relations began on this date. The Taiwan Relations Act became law in April 1979 and was made retroactively effective from January 1.

zh.n: 两国于这一天建立外交关系。《与台湾关系法》于1979年4月成法，并追溯自1月1日起生效。

en.s: Brunei, officially Brunei Darussalam, is a country in Southeast Asia, situated on the northern coast of the island of Borneo. en.t: Eastern Air Lines Flight 980 crashes into Mount Illimani in Bolivia, killing all 29 aboard
en.s: Eastern Air Lines Flight 980 was a scheduled international flight from Asunción, Paraguay, to Miami, Florida, United States. en.s: On 1 January 2026 at 01:26 (CET), during New Year celebrations, a fire broke out at Le Constellation bar in the ski-resort town of Crans-Montana, Valais, Switzerland. Forty-one people died in the fire, and 115 others were injured, with 83 initially being treated for severe burns. Intensive care units in Valais reached capacity, and victims were transported to hospitals in other parts of Switzerland and to other European countries.

zh.t: 2026年瑞士克朗-蒙大拿酒吧火灾
zh.s: 2026年1月1日中欧时间凌晨1时26分，瑞士瓦莱州滑雪度假小镇克朗-蒙大拿的Le Constellation酒吧在新年庆祝活动期间发生火灾，造成41人死亡、115人受伤，最初有83人因严重烧伤接受治疗。瓦莱州的重症监护病床全部占满，部分伤者被转送至瑞士其他地区及欧洲其他国家的医院。
